mapper.select: SELECT "o"."office_id" , "o"."operating_company_id" , "b"."operating_name" , "o"."name" , "o"."office_url" , "o"."phone_number" , "o"."available_flag" FROM "offices" "o" INNER JOIN "operating_companies" "b" ON "b"."del_flag" = 0 AND "b"."available_flag" = 1 AND "b"."operating_company_id" = "o"."operating_company_id" INNER JOIN "agencies" "a" ON "a"."del_flag" = 0 AND "a"."available_flag" = 1 AND "a"."business_corp_id" = "b"."business_corp_id" WHERE "o"."del_flag" = 0 AND "a"."business_corp_id" = #{businessCorpId} AND "o"."office_id" = #{officeId} ORDER BY "o"."office_id"

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM "offices" AS "o" JOIN "operating_companies" AS "c" ON "c"."operating_company_id" = "o"."operating_company_id" WHERE "o"."del_flag" = 0 AND "o"."available_flag" = 1 AND "c"."del_flag" = 0 AND "c"."available_flag" = 1 AND "c"."business_corp_id" = CAST(#{businessCorpId} AS INTEGER) AND "o"."office_id" = CAST(#{officeId} AS INTEGER)
